main_text.l: antiquis libris, ut cùm duę uoces isdē[?]
sit. ut in Sextiana nuper animaduerti-
mus, prope ab initio: Ego autem, iudi-
ces, qua uoce, &c. Legēdum enim est,
Quia qua uoce. nam etiam pro SER-
legendum puto, id est, in usum huius-
Interpretatio admittatur.) Id est, ne tam
mur. Sed mirum est, Ceruidium hoc
se multa in Aquilij formula: quasi
sint. qua de re libet Ciceronis locu ex
lib. De finibus v. adscribere: Quę cum
Zeno didicisset à nostris, ut in actioni-
dum puto, non PERSCRIBI,) de re ea

page.notes: Printed text with long s given as s and u/v, i/j normalised as instructed. Doubtful: "isdē" in the first line may be misread [?]. The lemma "VTILITA-TEM" and "SER-VIT" keep their printed line-end hyphens; the letter-spaced capitals are shown as plain capitals. A small stray mark after "tam" in the right column is typographic, not text. Edge fragments at the left and right margins belong to the neighbouring page and are omitted.
